messages:
Emma: Heads-up — saw a jump in webinar signups last week but MQL->SQL conversion slipped. Dashboard link: https://redwood.app/dashboards/marketing/webinar-funnel
Rahul: saw that. Is it concentrated in EMEA or cross-region?
Emma: Mostly EMEA, non-paid channels. Spike on Tue-Wed.
Sofie: Could be UTM tagging mismatch from the registration page. I remember a change on Tue 10am. @Liam any deploys?
Liam: yes, rolled a form change at 09:48 UTC Tuesday. small JS tweak to prefill utm_source. I didn't think it would affect attribution but maybe.
Emma: here's the funnel snapshot I pulled:
```
select date_trunc('day', created_at) as day, count(*) as regs, sum(case when status='mql' then 1 end) as mqls
from registrations where campaign='webinar-april' group by day order by day;
```
Rahul: can you add utm_source dimension? we need to see where those regs are landing.
Sofie: @MetricsBot could you run a quick crosswalk of registrations where utm_source is null vs non-null last 14 days?
MetricsBot: Running query now — ETA ~3m
Liam: quick thought: the prefill logic writes utm params to localStorage and then populates hidden inputs. If a redirect happened it might have cleared them.
Emma: OK can we prioritize: 1) confirm tagging gap 2) patch form to preserve params 3) backfill via registration logs or GA mappings
Rahul: I can take #3, will try to join an afternoon sync. Assigning myself. @Sofie will you own #2?
Sofie: yep will make a fix and smoke test. PR by EOD.
Emma: if backfill shows majority are organic, it changes attribution for paid budget. This should go to weekly KPI deck. I can slot a note for tomorrow's review.
Liam: PR created: https://github.com/redwood-inference/web-reg/pull/452 — testing on staging.
MetricsBot: Crosswalk done — 72% of the spike rows had utm_source=null between 2026-03-16 and 2026-03-18. CSV uploaded: https://s3.redwood/metrics/webinar-utm-gap.csv
Rahul: thanks. I'll start SQL backfill and share delta to KPI metrics channel.
Emma: perfect. Also flagging we should add a guard in the dashboard to show 'utm missing' as a segment — avoids surprises.
Sofie: added ticket MRKT-325 to product board.
Emma: cool. Wrap-up: Rahul backfill, Sofie fix, Liam validation, Emma update KPI deck. Any blockers?
Liam: none from infra side.
Rahul: none, will update in KPI channel when done.
Emma: :thumbsup:
